  PROBLEM: `_HEAL_PYTEST_CONFIG_NAMES` (line 1412) leaves out pytest's native TOML config names `pytest.toml` and `.pytest.toml`. `_HEAL_TEST_ONLY_PATH_RE` accepts `tests/pytest.toml` and `tests/.pytest.toml` as test-only paths, so line 1484 does not refuse them, and line 1486 then `continue`s past them because they do not end in `.py`.
  WHY: CI installs pytest unpinned (.github/workflows/ci.yml:235), and pytest reads `pytest.toml`/`.pytest.toml` ahead of `pyproject.toml`. A locked, auto-approved heal can therefore write `addopts` with `--deselect` into `tests/pytest.toml`, silently deselect the failing test, and still get `allow`. That is the bypass `pytest_config_changed` was meant to close. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1459-1465 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_test_only_counts` finds hooks only through `node.name in _HEAL_COLLECTION_HOOKS or node.name.startswith("pytest_")`. It never inspects `@pytest.hookimpl(specname=...)` decorators, and `pytest.hookimpl` is not in `_HEAL_SKIP_NAMES` (1406-1408), so a hook registered under an arbitrary function name goes unseen.
  WHY: A locked edit to `tests/conftest.py` can add `@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True, specname="pytest_runtest_makereport")` on a function with any name and rewrite the failing report to passed. The test, assert and skip counts do not change, so `run_heal_test_only_weakening_check` returns `allow`. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. minimax confidence 3, the others 4.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1483-1487 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After the `pytest_config_changed` check, the guard `if not (path.startswith("tests/") and path.endswith(".py"))` accepts every locked non-`.py` path outside `_HEAL_PYTEST_CONFIG_NAMES` without comparing file contents. This is a structural hole for any non-`.py` file under `tests/` that can affect collection.
  WHY: The reviewer says this is the channel through which `pytest_config_changed` is bypassed. The case actually exposed is the pytest.toml family. Rated MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:348-365 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `HEAL_TEST_ONLY_LOCK_FILE` guard runs `files_touched_scope_guard.py` before the transfer whenever that env var is set. There is no kill switch, so a misconfigured or leftover export pointing to an unreadable path makes the step exit 42 with `detail=test_only_lock`.
  WHY: The run is triggered implicitly by a single env var with nothing surfacing that state, so a leftover test-fixture export would fail every heal run at the transfer step. Rated NIT, mapped here to low.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:line 1412, _HEAL_PYTEST_CONFIG_NAMES = frozenset({"pytest.ini", ".pytest.ini", "tox.ini", "setup.cfg", "pyproject.toml"}), used at line 1484 in run_heal_test_only_weakening_check | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deny-list leaves out pytest 9's `pytest.toml` and `.pytest.toml`. `tests/pytest.toml` passes `heal_test_only_path_ok`, line 1484 does not refuse it, and line 1486 `continue`s past it because it is not `.py`.
  WHY: CI's pytest is unpinned (.github/workflows/ci.yml:235) and is called with tests/<file>.py arguments (ci.yml:250, 276, 504 and others), so `tests/pytest.toml` takes precedence over the root `pyproject.toml`. An `addopts` `--deselect` or `-k "not flaky"` entry there silently stops the failing test from running. Fix: add both names to the set and add refuse cases in `test_heal_test_only_weakening_check_refuses`.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:lines 1462-1465 in _heal_test_only_counts | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Hooks are detected only by a `pytest_` name prefix. pluggy's `specname=` registers a function with any name as the hook, and nothing at lines 1451-1454 counts `pytest.hookimpl`.
  WHY: `@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True, specname="pytest_runtest_makereport")` on `def rewrite(item, call)` can force the outcome to passed with every count unchanged, so the check returns allow. Fix: count `pytest.hookimpl` (with `specname`) as a skip control, about 3 lines plus a refuse case.
- NOTE: the failed copilot-pull-request-reviewer check fails with custom_instructions_too_large (HTTP 422). This is not a repository defect.
- HARDENING: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py, _HEAL_SKIP_NAMES, lines 1406-1408. `pytest.exit` is not counted, so `pytest.exit("done", returncode=0)` ends the session with exit code 0 before the failing test runs. Fix: add `"pytest.exit"` plus a refuse case (2 lines).
- HARDENING: changelog.d/8809-heal-test-only-auto-approve.md, in the sentence listing what the isolated heal editor refuses. It omits the `pytest_config_changed` refusal and the pytest_*/pytest_plugins controls. Fix: add "or adds or changes a pytest config file" (1 line).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every deliverable in issue #8809 has a matching hunk.
